prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1425; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured states they were turning left on a green arrow when the oncoming vehicle struck the driver's side. Police report requested. No other witnesses identified at this time.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder following the impact and says they have been seen at urgent care. Claimant confirmed they have no attorney at this time and is handling the matter directly. Explained the claims process and requested medical records and treatment notes.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by the insured. Damage visible to the front quarter panel and headlamp of the insured vehicle. Airbags did not deploy. Vehicle taken to the preferred repair shop for a written estimate. Liability appears likely to fall on the other driver based on the account given, pending police findings.

Entry 4: Received the police report. Officer cited the other driver for failure to yield on a left turn. Diagram matches the insured's account. Contacted the claimant to confirm the shoulder injury is still under treatment and to ask whether physical therapy has been recommended. Claimant states a follow-up appointment is scheduled and that work restrictions have been discussed with the physician.

Entry 5: Received medical records from urgent care showing a diagnosis of a right shoulder strain with range-of-motion limits. Claimant has not yet provided records from the follow-up visit. Sent a reminder for those records and noted that the claimant remains unrepresented. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the reported injury. Claim remains open pending medical updates and repair estimate.
